description: Header file defining template utility classes ExpandingArray and ExpandingArrayWithOptionalElem for handling arrays with repeated or optional elements, used within the PyTorch codebase.

classes.name: ExpandingArray
classes.description: A utility class that accepts either a container of D values or a single value, repeated D times.

classes.name: ExpandingArrayWithOptionalElem
classes.description: A utility class that accepts either a container of D std::optional<T> values or a single std::optional<T> value, repeated D times.

methods.name: ExpandingArray
methods.description: Constructors for ExpandingArray accepting initializer_list, vector, ArrayRef, single value, or std::array.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the extent D of the array.
